table.name: cards
table.purpose: One row per individual Magic: The Gathering card printing (card face within a specific set), from the MTGJSON/Scryfall-style dataset. Joins to sets, legalities, rulings, foreign_data via uuid/setCode.

artist.name: illustrator
artist.description: Name of the artist who illustrated the card.

asciiName.name: ascii_name
asciiName.description: ASCII-transliterated card name, populated only for cards whose original name contains non-ASCII characters (e.g. Arabian Nights cards like El-Hajjaj, Junun Efreet).

availability.name: availability
availability.description: Comma-separated list of platforms where the printing is available: paper, mtgo, arena, dreamcast, shandalar.

borderColor.name: border_color
borderColor.description: Color of the card border: black, white, silver (Un-sets), gold (championship decks), or borderless.

cardKingdomFoilId.name: cardkingdom_foil_product_id
cardKingdomFoilId.description: Card Kingdom store product ID for the foil version of this printing.

cardKingdomId.name: cardkingdom_product_id
cardKingdomId.description: Card Kingdom store product ID for the non-foil version of this printing.

colorIdentity.name: color_identity
colorIdentity.description: Comma-separated mana color letters (W,U,B,R,G) used for deck-building color identity (e.g. Commander); empty for colorless.

colorIndicator.name: color_indicator
colorIndicator.description: Color(s) shown by the color indicator symbol on cards with no mana cost (mostly reprinted cards and the back faces of double-faced cards).

colors.name: colors
colors.description: Comma-separated mana colors (W,U,B,R,G) in the card's mana cost; empty for colorless cards.

convertedManaCost.name: converted_mana_cost
convertedManaCost.description: Total generic mana value of the card (integer count of all mana symbols in the cost); the 1000000 max is the placeholder for cards with variable/unpayable costs (e.g. {X} or no cost).

duelDeck.name: duel_deck_side
duelDeck.description: For Duel Decks anthologies/cards: which deck the card belongs to, 'a' or 'b'.

edhrecRank.name: edhrec_rank
edhrecRank.description: Popularity rank of the card on EDHREC (Commander format popularity site); lower is more popular.

faceConvertedManaCost.name: face_converted_mana_cost
faceConvertedManaCost.description: Mana value of just this face of a multi-faced card (split/transform cards), populated only for such cards.

faceName.name: face_name
faceName.description: Name of this individual face of a multi-faced card (split, transform, adventure cards like Fire//Ice, Bonecrusher Giant).

flavorName.name: flavor_name
flavorName.description: Alternate 'flavor' name used on promotional printings (e.g. the Godzilla-series Ikoria cards: Spacegodzilla, Rodan, etc.).

flavorText.name: flavor_text
flavorText.description: Flavor text printed on the card (non-rules, lore text).

frameEffects.name: frame_effects
frameEffects.description: Comma-separated list of special card-frame treatments: legendary, extendedart, showcase, nyxtouched, miracle, snow, etc.

frameVersion.name: frame_version
frameVersion.description: Card frame design era: 1993, 1997, 2003, 2015, or 'future' (Future Sight frame).

hand.name: hand_modifier
hand.description: Starting hand-size modifier, used only by Vanguard cards (e.g. +1/-2 hand modifier).

hasAlternativeDeckLimit.name: has_alternative_deck_limit
hasAlternativeDeckLimit.description: Whether the card allows an alternative deck-building limit (e.g. Relentless Rats / Shadowborn Apostle style 'any number of copies' cards).

hasContentWarning.name: has_content_warning
hasContentWarning.description: Whether the card carries a content warning (racially or culturally offensive imagery/text, e.g. Invoke Prejudice).

hasFoil.name: has_foil
hasFoil.description: Whether this printing exists in foil version.

hasNonFoil.name: has_non_foil
hasNonFoil.description: Whether this printing exists in non-foil version.

id.name: row_id
id.description: Auto-incrementing primary key of this table (row identifier).

isAlternative.name: is_alternative
isAlternative.description: Whether this printing is an alternate version of a card in the same set (alternate art/frames within a set).

isFullArt.name: is_full_art
isFullArt.description: Whether the card has full-art treatment (art extends to card edges, e.g. basic lands from Zendikar/Unstable).

isOnlineOnly.name: is_online_only
isOnlineOnly.description: Whether the card exists only in digital form (MTGO/Arena only, never printed in paper).

isOversized.name: is_oversized
isOversized.description: Whether the card is an oversized (collector/promo) printing.

isPromo.name: is_promo
isPromo.description: Whether the printing is a promotional card.

isReprint.name: is_reprint
isReprint.description: Whether this printing is a reprint of a card first printed in an earlier set.

isReserved.name: is_reserved_list
isReserved.description: Whether the card is on the Reserved List (Wizards' promise never to reprint certain 1990s cards).

isStarter.name: is_starter
isStarter.description: Whether the card is found in a starter deck / intro pack / other non-booster product rather than boosters.

isStorySpotlight.name: is_story_spotlight
isStorySpotlight.description: Whether the card is a story spotlight card (tied to the set's narrative).

isTextless.name: is_textless
isTextless.description: Whether the card is textless (no rules text box, e.g. full-art textless promos).

isTimeshifted.name: is_timeshifted
isTimeshifted.description: Whether the card is a timeshifted printing (purple-symbol reprints in Time Spiral, old-frame cards in Time Spiral Remastered/Mystery Booster).

keywords.name: keyword_abilities
keywords.description: Comma-separated list of keyword abilities on the card (Flying, Trample, Cycling, Equip, etc.).

layout.name: card_layout
layout.description: Card layout type: normal, split, transform, modal_dfc, adventure, leveler, augment, scheme, etc.

leadershipSkills.name: leadership_skills
leadershipSkills.description: Serialized flags for which formats the card can be a commander in: brawl, commander, oathbreaker.

life.name: life_modifier
life.description: Starting life total modifier, used only by Vanguard cards.

loyalty.name: starting_loyalty
loyalty.description: Starting loyalty of a planeswalker card; stored as text because values can be variable ('*', '1d4+1').

manaCost.name: mana_cost
manaCost.description: Mana cost in MTG symbol notation, e.g. {1}{W}, {R/G}{R/G}; null for lands and face-up cards with no cost.

mcmId.name: cardmarket_product_id
mcmId.description: Cardmarket (MCM) product ID for this printing.

mcmMetaId.name: cardmarket_meta_product_id
mcmMetaId.description: Cardmarket meta-product ID (grouping of printings of the same card across sets).

mtgArenaId.name: mtg_arena_id
mtgArenaId.description: MTG Arena internal card ID, present only for cards available on Arena.

mtgjsonV4Id.name: mtgjson_v4_uuid
mtgjsonV4Id.description: Legacy MTGJSON v4 UUID for this printing (version-5 UUIDs, distinct from the current uuid column).

mtgoFoilId.name: mtgo_foil_id
mtgoFoilId.description: MTGO catalog ID for the foil version of this printing on Magic Online.

mtgoId.name: mtgo_id
mtgoId.description: MTGO catalog ID for the non-foil version of this printing on Magic Online.

multiverseId.name: multiverse_id
multiverseId.description: Gatherer/Wizards of the Coast multiverse ID for this printing; null for cards not in Gatherer (promos, online-only).

name.name: card_name
name.description: Card name (front face name for multi-faced cards). Duplicated across rows because the same card is printed in many sets.

number.name: collector_number
number.description: Collector number within the set; alphanumeric with prefixes/suffixes (e.g. '22c', 'br79', 'jf324' for promo variants).

originalReleaseDate.name: original_release_date
originalReleaseDate.description: Release date of the original printing of the card, populated only for promo/reprint cards whose original release predates the set (e.g. From the Vault, Secret Lair).

originalText.name: original_rules_text
originalText.description: Rules text as printed at the time of this printing (older wording), kept for reference alongside the modern oracle text.

originalType.name: original_type_line
originalType.description: Card type line as originally printed (e.g. 'Summon - Fungus' for very old cards), alongside the modern type.

otherFaceIds.name: other_face_uuids
otherFaceIds.description: Comma-separated UUIDs of the other faces of a multi-faced card (split/transform/modal DFC/adventure cards).

power.name: power
power.description: Creature power as printed; stored as text because values can be variable ('*', '2+*').

printings.name: printing_set_codes
printings.description: Comma-separated list of set codes in which this card (by name) has ever been printed.

promoTypes.name: promo_types
promoTypes.description: Comma-separated promotional categories for promo cards: prerelease, datestamped, mediainsert, boxtopper, convention, etc.

purchaseUrls.name: purchase_urls
purchaseUrls.description: Serialized dict of affiliate purchase links per vendor (cardKingdom, cardKingdomFoil, cardmarket, tcgplayer) via mtgjson.com redirect links.

rarity.name: rarity
rarity.description: Rarity of this printing: common, uncommon, rare, or mythic.

scryfallId.name: scryfall_id
scryfallId.description: Scryfall card ID (UUID) for this printing; a few duplicates exist for tokens/variants sharing artwork entries.

scryfallIllustrationId.name: scryfall_illustration_id
scryfallIllustrationId.description: Scryfall illustration ID, shared by all printings using the same artwork.

scryfallOracleId.name: scryfall_oracle_id
scryfallOracleId.description: Scryfall oracle ID, shared by all printings of the same card (same name/rules text) across sets.

setCode.name: set_code
setCode.description: Code of the set this printing belongs to (e.g. 2XM, MB1, PRM, 10E); references sets.code.

side.name: face_side
side.description: For multi-faced cards: which face this row represents (a, b, c, d, e).

subtypes.name: subtypes
subtypes.description: Comma-separated card subtypes (creature types like Human,Wizard; Aura; land types like Forest).

supertypes.name: supertypes
supertypes.description: Comma-separated supertypes: Basic, Legendary, Snow, World, Ongoing.

tcgplayerProductId.name: tcgplayer_product_id
tcgplayerProductId.description: TCGplayer store product ID for this printing.

text.name: rules_text
text.description: Current (oracle) rules text of the card; includes reminder text. Basic lands show '({T}: Add {G}.)' etc.

toughness.name: toughness
toughness.description: Creature toughness as printed; stored as text because values can be variable ('*', '*+1').

type.name: type_line
type.description: Full type line as printed, e.g. 'Creature — Kor Artificer', 'Basic Land — Plains'.

types.name: card_types
types.description: Comma-separated primary card types (Creature, Instant, Sorcery, Land, Enchantment, Artifact, Summon on very old cards).

uuid.name: uuid
uuid.description: MTGJSON v5 UUID uniquely identifying this printing; referenced by legalities, foreign_data, and rulings tables.

variations.name: variation_uuids
variations.description: Comma-separated UUIDs of other printings of the same card within the same set (alternate arts/frames).

watermark.name: watermark
watermark.description: Watermark printed on the card: faction names (mirran, phyrexian, golgari, dimir, izzet) or 'set (CODE)' for set-symbol watermarks.

table.name: foreign_data
table.purpose: Localized (non-English) card data for Magic: The Gathering cards: each row is a card's name, rules text, type, and flavor text translated into a specific language, linked to the card record in the cards table via uuid.

flavorText.name: flavor_text
flavorText.description: Flavor text of the card in the row's language; empty string when the card has no flavor text.

id.name: id
id.description: Primary key; surrogate auto-increment row id.

language.name: language
language.description: Human-readable name of the language of this translation (e.g. Japanese, French, German, Ancient Greek, Sanskrit).

multiverseid.name: multiverse_id
multiverseid.description: Gatherer multiverse ID of the printed card in this language; null when the printing has no Gatherer entry.

name.name: card_name
name.description: Card name translated into the row's language.

text.name: rules_text
text.description: Card rules/abilities text in the row's language; empty string for cards with no rules text.

type.name: card_type
type.description: Card type line (card type and creature subtype) translated into the row's language; empty string when unavailable.

uuid.name: card_uuid
uuid.description: Foreign key to cards.uuid identifying the (English) card this translation belongs to; one card can have many language rows.

table.name: legalities
table.purpose: Per-card format legality records for a Magic: The Gathering card database (MTGJSON-style). Each row states whether one card (identified by uuid) is legal, banned, or restricted in one tournament format. A card typically has one row per applicable format (up to 15).

format.name: tournament format
format.description: The Magic: The Gathering tournament format in which the legality status applies. 15 distinct values matching known MTG formats: commander, legacy, vintage, duel (Duel Commander), modern, pauper, pioneer, premodern, penny (Penny Dreadful), etc.

id.name: row id
id.description: Surrogate primary key for this legality row. The detected joins to cards.mcmId / cardKingdomId etc. are spurious numeric coincidences, not real relationships.

status.name: legality status
status.description: Legality of the card in the given format: Legal (playable, any number of copies), Banned (not playable), Restricted (only one copy allowed, e.g. Vintage restricted list).

uuid.name: card uuid
uuid.description: Foreign key to cards.uuid identifying the card whose legality is being stated. Each card appears up to 15 times (once per format).

table.name: rulings
table.purpose: MTG card rulings: official rules clarifications issued for specific cards, each row linking a ruling text and its issue date to a card (via cards.uuid).

date.name: ruling_date
date.description: Date the ruling was issued (2004-10-04 to 2021-02-05).

id.name: ruling_id
id.description: Primary key; sequential integer identifier for each ruling.

text.name: ruling_text
text.description: Official ruling text explaining how the card's ability/interaction works.

uuid.name: card_uuid
uuid.description: Foreign key to cards.uuid; the card the ruling applies to. Repeats because a card can have many rulings (and shared printings share a uuid).

table.name: set_translations
table.purpose: Localized (translated) names of Magic: The Gathering card sets; one row per (set, language) pair, 121 sets x 10 languages. References the sets table by set code.

id.name: id
id.description: Synthetic primary key; sequential integer 1-1210, one per row.

language.name: language
language.description: Full name of the language the set name is translated into (e.g. Chinese Simplified, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Russian). 10 distinct values, each appearing 121 times (one per set).

setCode.name: set_code
setCode.description: Code of the Magic: The Gathering set (e.g. 10E, M14, RTR, TSP); references sets.code (many-to-one). 121 distinct codes, each appearing 10 times (once per language).

translation.name: translated_set_name
translation.description: The set's name translated into the given language (e.g. 'Ritorno a Ravnica' = Italian for 'Return to Ravnica', '미로딘 포위전' = Korean for 'Mirrodin Besieged'). Null (~19%) where no translation exists for that language/set; when null the set presumably has no localized name.

table.name: sets
table.purpose: Magic: The Gathering card sets/expansions (one row per set, e.g. expansions, promos, core sets), with metadata such as release date, set type, block, booster contents, and external marketplace IDs. Referenced by cards and set_translations via the set code.

baseSetSize.name: base_set_size
baseSetSize.description: Number of distinct cards in the set excluding variants (base set size, as in MTGJSON); 0 for sets with no cards.

block.name: block
block.description: Name of the Magic block the set belongs to (e.g. 'Theros', 'Shadows over Innistrad') or a grouping label for non-blocked sets (e.g. 'Core Set', 'Commander', 'Judge Gift Cards'). Null for sets not part of a block.

booster.name: booster_contents
booster.description: JSON string describing booster pack composition per booster type (e.g. 'default', 'arena'): number of commons, uncommons, rares/mythics, lands, etc. Null for sets without booster packs (promos, memorabilia).

code.name: set_code
code.description: Unique short code identifying the set (e.g. 'TSP' = Time Spiral, '10E' = Tenth Edition). Referenced by cards.setCode and set_translations.setCode.

id.name: set_id
id.description: Primary key; sequential integer identifier for the set row.

isFoilOnly.name: is_foil_only
isFoilOnly.description: 1 if all cards in the set exist only in foil version, else 0.

isForeignOnly.name: is_foreign_only
isForeignOnly.description: 1 if the set was released only in a language other than English, else 0.

isNonFoilOnly.name: is_non_foil_only
isNonFoilOnly.description: 1 if all cards in the set exist only in non-foil version, else 0.

isOnlineOnly.name: is_online_only
isOnlineOnly.description: 1 if the set exists only in digital form (MTGO/Arena), else 0.

isPartialPreview.name: is_partial_preview
isPartialPreview.description: 1 if the set is only a partial preview of an upcoming set, else 0.

keyruneCode.name: keyrune_code
keyruneCode.description: Code of the Keyrune icon (set symbol) used for this set; often shared across related sets (e.g. 'PMEI' for many promos, 'DCI' for tournament promos), so it differs from the set code.

mcmId.name: mcm_id
mcmId.description: Set ID at MKM/Cardmarket (MCM = Magic Card Market); null when the set is not listed there.

mcmIdExtras.name: mcm_id_extras
mcmIdExtras.description: Additional Cardmarket ID for extra products/expansions of the set (e.g. special sub-products); populated for very few sets.

mcmName.name: mcm_name
mcmName.description: Name of the set as listed on Cardmarket (MCM); null when not listed there.

mtgoCode.name: mtgo_code
mtgoCode.description: Set code as used by Magic: The Gathering Online (may differ from the main set code); null for sets not available on MTGO.

name.name: set_name
name.description: Full human-readable name of the set (e.g. 'Ultimate Masters', 'Magic 2010').

parentCode.name: parent_set_code
parentCode.description: Set code of the parent set this set belongs to (e.g. a promo set tied to an expansion); null for standalone sets.

releaseDate.name: release_date
releaseDate.description: Release date of the set (YYYY-MM-DD), ranging from 1993-08-05 (Alpha) to 2021-03-19.

tcgplayerGroupId.name: tcgplayer_group_id
tcgplayerGroupId.description: TCGplayer group (category) ID for the set; null when the set is not sold on TCGplayer.

totalSetSize.name: total_set_size
totalSetSize.description: Total number of distinct cards in the set including variants (always >= baseSetSize).
